behaviors.description: Install, update, uninstall and bundle operation identity.
preconditions: Prepared query A/B repositories and plain bundle
expected: Ready getters identify exact requested ref/type and applicable origin; bundle getter is NULL or supplied GFile; current operation equals executing callback operation; exact resulting commits and uninstall absence.

behaviors.description: Shared runtime and extension operation causes, including skipped apps.
preconditions: Two apps share runtime and extension; independently updated runtime
expected: Runtime names both requesting apps, extension names main runtime, explicit apps have no cause, unchanged app causes report skipped on runtime update.

behaviors.description: Resolved B metadata and old A permissions.
expected: Exact B commit, full new and old keyfiles, and NULL unsubsetting at ready.

behaviors.description: Per-ref size getters match immutable reference commit metadata and uninstall zeros.
preconditions: fixture.sizes[version][fullref] prepared by reference ostree from xa.installed-size and xa.download-size
expected: Each app/runtime operation size equals its own reference-prepared literal, excluding dependency sizes; uninstall sizes are zero.

mappings.rationale: Native install/update/uninstall/bundle-install requests yield exact requested ref and enum type, applicable origin and nullable bundle GFile. Each execution callback compares owned get_current_operation pointer to its operation argument. Independent commit expectations and uninstall absence verify execution.

Ready traverses borrowed causes while transaction lives; shared runtime identifies both apps, extension its runtime, explicit apps no causes. Runtime-only update exposes both unchanged skipped app causes and excludes their execution.
Prepared A and B differ in network permission. At ready compare entire old/new metadata keyfiles and exact B commit; C asserts NULL subpaths; abort preserves A.

Feed per-ref immutable xa.installed-size and xa.download-size literals collected by reference ostree at preparation into C assertions. Each app/runtime operation must match its own literal, excluding dependencies; both uninstall sizes must be zero. No target size API supplies expected values.
